There used to be animated scrolling episode backgrounds, soundtracks composed by an orchestra, gameplay that’s not too fast, characters in every episode, basically everything that I remember about Candy Crush Soda Saga. But now there’s only one background for each level and the diorama, the same diorama since last year, a different font from the one that used to be in the game when it launched, gameplay that feels too fast, and the main character, Kimmy, is nowhere to be found. The only appearances she makes are when you combine a color bomb and a coloring candy. My ideas to make it feel more like it did in 2014 are:

- Slow down the gameplay
- Bring back Kimmy
- Bring back the old font
- Add the feature to switch between dioramas with characters by swiping on the screen
- Bring back Kimmy’s Arcade
- Add a feature that lets you switch between soundtracks
- Change “Four In A Row” back to “Mr. Toffee’s Fair”

So that’s basically all I have to talk about. Thank you for reading this message!

author: renenzo
title: PLEA FOR AD WARNINGS AND CONTENT OPTIONS
content:
I have severe panic disorder and the attacks cause psychological fear and physical symptoms that go along with it, such as panic attacks, dangerously high heart rate, cold sweats, chest pain, vomiting, dizziness, stress, fear of recurrence (a rac hno ph obia in this case), nightmares, needing medications and CBT, shaking, and not being able to move/leave once i’ve found a safe space (usually with my phone or tablet as a diversion). There is an ad for this game that sometimes follows a win on a game called “Cryptogram” in which a very real looking sp ide r crawls across the screen twice. The first time I saw it, I threw my phone as a reflex and have dropped it several times. Even turning my phone over at ad-time, I still get cold sweats, shakiness, blurry vision, and anxiety when I play games. I used to feel that games on my phone were a safe place and a way to combat panic disorder and divert anxieties, but they’re now a trigger. 
I realize I’m in a very tiny minority here, but that doesn’t make it any less real or problematic for me. I cannot find a way to block this game’s ads so I can use my phone like the majority of the unafflicted. Please understand that this is a  problem I’ve been dealing with for as long as I can remember, and mitigating causes is the easiest, most effective way to avoid symptomatic states of mind. I doubt this will be read by anyone who can alter the ad and make me less afraid of using the internet or playing games, but as someone who clearly has (and needs) regular medical and therapeutic appointments, I spend a lot of time in waiting rooms where a phone or tablet is (or was) the easiest way to pass the time. No doubt this will be humorous to many, and I am used to that reaction from people, but it is (perhaps laughably) a very real, an unequivocally stressful thing to go through when it should not be an issue, or at least able to opt out of seeing. If you’ve made it this far, thank you for your time and hopefully for creating a way to eradicate stressors and content for everyone’s unique circumstances, not just my own.
